title: Bouguer gravity maps (1 milligal contour interval) of the Dyson, Shoals Junction and Abbeville East quadrangles. Maps and gravity station data
citation: Lawrence, D.P., 1985, Bouguer gravity maps (1 milligal contour interval) of the Dyson, Shoals Junction and Abbeville East quadrangles. Maps and gravity station data: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-47, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Three sheets (Dyson, Abbeville East, Shoals Junction 7.5-minute quadrangles), each a simple Bouguer gravity map (one milligal contour interval, 1930 I.G.F. subtracted, Bouguer density 2.67) on a USGS topographic base. The OCR of the map faces is noise: no gravity contour labels or station values are legible, and gravity anomalies are not geologic units, structures, surfaces or tests the schema holds. Legend items (gravity contour, gravity station) are legend-only. Nothing recorded. SUBSURFACE: none.
